name: Rope of Mending

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A rope that mends itself when cut.
text: You can cut this 50-foot coil of hempen rope into any number of smaller pieces, and then take a Magic action to speak a command word and cause the pieces to knit back together. (No other effect in the game.)
